visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a young woman with long dark hair wearing a bright yellow headband; her eyes are wide and her mouth is open in an expression of shock. The background is a rustic, weathered wooden wall. (2) A transition occurs to a static shot of a bed covered with a colorful striped blanket inside a room with rough, sandy stone walls that resemble a cave. (3) The scene shifts to a high-angle selfie shot of the woman smiling, wearing a white crochet hat; she is positioned against a sprawling backdrop of a historic stone village built into a mountainside under a clear blue sky. (4) A sequence shows several men in green and white traditional attire kneeling and bowing on a carpeted floor inside a mosque with modern lighting. (5) Inside a car, the woman and a man are seen talking to a driver; the woman wears a pearl-studded crochet hat while the driver, a man with a beard and sunglasses, wears a white robe. (6) The camera captures wide shots of Thee Ain Heritage Village, an ancient city constructed from stacked flat stones, showcasing its terraced architecture against steep rocky mountains. (7) The woman is seen climbing steep stone stairs and walking through narrow alleys of the ancient village, touching the rough texture of the stone walls. (8) A sequence at a natural spring shows water cascading down rocks into a stream where several children are playing and splashing; the woman dips her hands into the clear water. (9) The woman and her companion are shown trying on traditional Saudi garments in a shop filled with colorful rugs; she wears a black embroidered gown, and he wears a thick white wool cloak with tassels. (10) The final phase shows the woman sitting on a high-speed train, looking out the window at a desert landscape during sunset.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 大震驚... (2) [Subtitle]: 洞房竟然有晃到不行的床... (3) [Variety]: 好色喔... (4) [Slogan]: 這個藏在沙漠深處. 建築在石壁上的. 神秘黃金城. (5) [Logo]: 被沙烏地朋友包養之旅. EP.6. (一早陪Lid來朝拜). (6) [Variety]: (有點緊張...). (7) [Subtitle]: 我好奇這裡有女生不能做的工作嗎? 只有一種工作. 那律師呢? 律師可以的! 對都可以~ 那軍人呢? 不!當然不可以. 也許她們會幫忙醫護照護這方面的. (8) [Variety]: 喔~ (出現了!). (9) [Slogan]: YES!! 太美了! (10) [Subtitle]: Thee Ain Heritage Village. 這裡可以說是整個阿拉伯半島裡面. 保存最古老最完整的一座古城! 當地朋友說已經有400年的歷史! 整個範圍有80多棟. 但每棟裡面都藏著5層樓. 完全是用石頭堆砌. 他說這是大石頭擺上去之後用小石頭去填他. (11) [Slogan]: 這裡太狂了! (12) [Subtitle]: 可是至今卻完全沒有人居住! (13) [Slogan]: 這是他們清真寺誒! (14) [Logo]: (Lid朝拜中). (15) [Subtitle]: 傳說中全村為了找回一位村民的手杖. 意外在沙漠裡找到了無限山泉水! 不只找回了手杖又滋養了村落. (16) [Variety]: 好涼喔. (17) [Subtitle]: 接著被Lid帶去觀光客絕對到不了. 750年歷史的古城! 穆薩傳統村. 這裡曾經是沙烏地打贏土耳其. 保衛他們家園的痕跡. 去了地道探險. 最高軍事據點. 地底朝拜房. 洞房還有晃到不行的床... (18) [Variety]: 好色喔. (19) [Subtitle]: 我現在穿的是他們的傳統服裝! 想像一下披著地毯在地上走的感覺. (20) [Logo]: 《被沙烏地朋友包養兩週》到底還有多少我們不認識的沙漠土豪國? (21) [Slogan]: 下一集我們將搭上橫越沙漠時速300高鐵! (22) [Subtitle]: 換裝混入『觀光客的禁地』.
